abilities.name: Valorous Brand
abilities.text: Each Basic Ability marks enemy Heroes hit for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks consume the target's marks, dealing 20% bonus damage per mark and healing for 75 per mark.

abilities.name: Celestial Charge
abilities.text: Lunge towards a targeted direction and stab, dealing 35 damage. If an enemy Hero is hit, Channel to Stun for 1 second and deal 80 additional damage when it fully finishes.

abilities.name: Solarion's Fire
abilities.text: Release a fiery wave that deals 110 damage. Enemies hit by the center take 50% bonus damage and are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Molten Armor
abilities.text: Shroud Imperius in flames for 3 seconds, striking a nearby enemy for 19 damage every 0.25 seconds. Imperius heals for 50% of the damage dealt, increased to 100% against Heroes. Strikes 2 additional targets if no Heroes are in range, and restores 1 Mana for each strike on expiration.

abilities.name: Angelic Armaments
abilities.text:
Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850 Shield for 3 seconds.

If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140 damage to the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Angiris
abilities.text:
After 0.75 seconds, charge in the target direction, lifting the first enemy Hero hit into the Heavens. While in the air, Imperius can steer the landing location by moving.

After 2 seconds, slam the target into the ground, dealing 250 damage to them, increased by 20% for each Valorous Brand on the target when landing, and Stunning them for 1 second.

1.name: Impaling Light
1.text:
Celestial Charge deals 150% more damage to Heroes, reduced by 25% for each additional Hero hit. For each Valorous Brand on the target when Celestial Charge's Stun completes, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

Passive: Reduce Celestial Charge's cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and its Mana cost from 40 to 30.

1.name: Consuming Flame
1.text: Increase the center damage of Solarion's Fire by an additional 125% and its Slow amount by 15%. The first enemy Hero hit with Solarion's Fire restores 30 Mana.

1.name: Burn the Impure
1.text: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark deals bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

4.name: Sovereign Armor
4.text: Molten Armor grants 20 Armor for 1.5 seconds. Hitting an enemy Hero with Molten Armor extends the duration of this Armor by 0.5 seconds.

4.name: Battle Hunger
4.text: Increase the healing of Valorous Brand by 80%.

4.name: Press Forward
4.text: Gain 10 Armor while being healed by a Regeneration Globe. Damaging an enemy Hero sets the duration of an active Regeneration Globe on Imperius to 8 seconds (unless it is already higher).

7.name: Flash of Anger
7.text: Consuming a mark from Celestial Charge deals 150 damage to the target and nearby enemies and grants Imperius a 250 point Shield for 4 seconds.

7.name: Blaze of Glory
7.text: Solarion's Fire leaves a line of scorched earth along its center that explodes after 1.75 seconds for 212 damage, dealing bonus damage with Valorous Brand marks.

7.name: Holy Fervor
7.text: Activate to reset Imperius's Basic Attack cooldown and cause the next 4 Basic Attacks within 10 seconds to cleave for 30% additional damage.

10.name: Angelic Armaments
10.text:
Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850 Shield for 3 seconds.

If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140 damage to the first enemy hit.

10.name: Wrath of the Angiris
10.text:
After 0.75 seconds, charge in the target direction, lifting the first enemy Hero hit into the Heavens. While in the air, Imperius can steer the landing location by moving.

After 2 seconds, slam the target into the ground, dealing 250 damage to them, increased by 20% for each Valorous Brand on the target when landing, and Stunning them for 1 second.

13.name: Pathetic Mortals
13.text: Stunning enemy Heroes with Celestial Charge reduces their Movement Speed by 25% and their damage by 50% for 4 seconds.

13.name: Divine Rage
13.text: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark reduces the cooldown of Molten Armor by 1 second.

13.name: Heat of Battle
13.text: Increase Molten Armor's healing against Heroes by 2% for every 1% Health Imperius is missing.

16.name: Celestial Swiftness
16.text: Gain 20% Movement Speed for 5 seconds after casting Celestial Charge. Gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds for each Hero Stunned with Celestial Charge.

16.name: Melting Touch
16.text: Consuming a Molten Armor mark reduces the target's Armor by 25 for 4 seconds.

16.name: Valorous Pursuit
16.text: Activate to teleport to an enemy that has been marked by Valorous Brand and gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

20.name: Heavenly Host
20.text:
Shields granted by Angelic Armaments no longer expire, and on initial activation, nearby allied Heroes gain a Shield that absorbs 600 damage.

If a Shield granted to an allied Hero lasts 3 seconds, it fires 1 sword at a nearby enemy, prioritizing closest Heroes, dealing 140 damage.

20.name: Unrelenting Descent
20.text: Descending from the Heavens restores 30% of Imperius' maximum Health and Mana. Consuming a Valorous Brand reduces the cooldown of Wrath of the Angiris by 10 seconds.

20.name: Molten Wrath
20.text: Molten Armor's radius is increased by 25%, and it always strikes 2 additional targets, even if there are Heroes in range.

20.name: Brand of Solarion
20.text: Reduce the duration of Valorous Brand to 5 seconds, but it is no longer consumed when triggered.

20.name: Impervious
20.text: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 75 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Hitting Heroes with the center of Solarion's Fire reduces this cooldown by 5 seconds.
